title: badf_id_sweep: refuse a required surface that is present but unusable, and print READ only for a surface actually read
objective: Close #323: badf_id_sweep read a present-but-empty, whitespace-only or wrong-encoding required dump as clean -- exit 0, READ (0 id occurrence(s)), next-free wrong by twenty -- because the positive-control anchors live only in ledger and the read used errors='replace'. Refuse such a required surface with a message distinct from the missing-dump refusal, make READ falsifiable, turn an unreadable dump into a refusal instead of a traceback, and follow SARCHI's criterion-6 ruling. Carry the WP-2026-0151 reconcile.
business_value: Removes the one path by which the id-allocation tool gives a confident wrong answer instead of a refusal -- the realistic failure being a gather that failed after shell redirection truncated its dump -- in a repository that has had three id collisions in one session.
in_scope: scripts/badf_id_sweep.py: read_surface() -- strict UTF-8, refuse 0 bytes / whitespace only / undecodable / OSError as PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE; required surfaces exit 1 naming the remedy for an honest empty gather; an unusable optional comments dump is reported PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE, never READ

tests/test_badf_id_sweep.py: DegenerateSurfaceTests per #323's test list, every required surface checked via the module's own tuples; the default fixture's 0-byte pr_files.txt becomes a declared honest empty
carry the WP-2026-0151 reconcile, written by `badf_gate.py reconcile WP-2026-0151` (CLOSED, landed_as 9f1b42b, composition_verified true)
out_of_scope: the documented gather one-liners in GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md -- #323 puts the gather procedure out of scope. The pr_files loop writes 0 bytes when no PRs are open, so it is now refused until the operator declares the empty result; recording each gather's exit status is SARCHI's preferred follow-up
CLAIM_SURFACES / PROSE_SURFACES and id matching (#323 out of scope)
#284's characterization test -- it never landed (no test in the tree references #323 or #284), so there is nothing to invert; #284 stays open
the G07 self-dossier -- assembly is HUMAN_REQUIRED; declared, not worked around
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: an empty or whitespace-only required dump exits 1 with 'PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE', distinguishable from 'missing surface dump'
AC-2: a dump that does not decode as strict UTF-8 is refused, never errors='replace'd
AC-3: READ is printed only for a surface that decoded and is not blank; an unusable optional surface is reported PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE
AC-4: every required surface (ledger, branches, pr_files, bodies, from the module's own tuples) is refused when degenerate -- not only ledger
AC-5: an OSError on read (PermissionError injected, since chmod 000 does not deny under a root harness) is a refusal, not a traceback

AC-6 (SARCHI's ruling): a non-empty dump with no ids is READ (0) as an honest zero; a legitimately empty gather left at 0 bytes is refused with the remedy named -- the declared non-covered case; no predicate keys on 'no ids found'
failing-first: the new tests fail on the pre-change tool; ADVERSARIAL: seven seeded defects each turn the file red
evidence: composition record + CI compose composition: CURRENT and suite OK

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: C1: a refusal added to an operator tool; no gate, schema or control code changes. The SURFACES header gains a PRESENT BUT UNUSABLE state for the optional surface; nothing in the tree parses that header but the tool's own tests. The full suite runs in CI on the composed tree; this session's background limit is shorter than the suite.
